gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mandali: Mandali opens the eye of its e generously, friendly and clean. Beneath Pixelify Sans, whose rounded-rod strokes never change weight, a full paragraph of Mandali keeps flowing without any letter clogging up.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-meera-inimai: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, with a c like a bent paperclip. It grabs attention at display size, while Meera Inimai gives open-ended curves room to breathe and keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mina: Loud, unwavering lines: Pixelify Sans never changes its weight. Mina quietly takes over with plain strokes and generously unclosed curves on every small round letter, where the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-molengo: Loud, pen-drawn lines: Pixelify Sans holds one width throughout. Molengo follows with wide gaps that keep tiny letters crisp, so paragraphs stay clear and comfortable from the first line to the last.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-monda: Approachable and clean, Monda keeps its small counters unclogged. Pixelify Sans is best for bold uppercase built from lines of constant thickness, while Monda handles the quieter work of running text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-nanum-gothic: Pipe-cleaner strokes, bold and expressive: that is Pixelify Sans. Nanum Gothic brings wide channels into each counter, so a full page of sans-serif text reads smoothly and feels contemporary.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-national-park: A c as open as a bent paperclip gives Pixelify Sans its bold, expressive look. And National Park, drawn like a pen that never changes pressure, reads cleanly down a whole column.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-niramit: Hairline-free, swell-free letters: that is Pixelify Sans, loud and expressive. Niramit sits below with curves that look like they are gaping, a clean, professional text face that stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-linear: Noto Sans Linear B gives each bend a smooth, unobstructed path. If Pixelify Sans, with no visible difference between its up and side strokes, is made small, it loses its punch next to the body.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-nko: Rounded-nib lettering with no swelling at stroke ends: Pixelify Sans. Give it generous display size, and let Noto Sans NKo, with c openings you can see through, handle the text at a modest size.
